lines.zh: 我一步一步地迈，关节很硬
lines.en: I take stiff steps; the joints are rigid.

lines.zh: 稻草从我的袖口掉出来
lines.en: Straw falls from my sleeves.
The field packs under my feet.

lines.zh: 我朝着被踩坏的那片走
lines.en: I head for the patch that was trampled.

lines.zh: 我的影子在田垄上很长
lines.en: My shadow lies long across the rows.
Wind tilts my ragged hat.
Every three steps, I pause.
My stick-arms swing stiffly.
I walk along the fence.
Soil clings to my base.
I walk to the middle of the field and stop.
Straw feet make no sound.

lines.zh: 我立在田中间，像个路标
lines.en: I stand mid-field like a signpost.

lines.zh: 鸟都不敢落在我的帽上
lines.en: No bird dares land on my hat.
The wind passes through me.
I am watching the thieves.
A smile is painted on my face.
The straw rattles inside my sleeves.
I keep watch over this field.

lines.zh: 我几百年没动过，也没人问
lines.en: Years without moving, and no one asks.
The clouds have sunk low; my straw will soak.
I turn my head slowly.
I tip my hat brim up to look at you.
You have stepped into my field.
A painted smile is on my face.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着刚拔的东西
lines.en: You hold what you just pulled up.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人在这里弯腰
lines.en: I dislike people bending down here.
I say very little.
You have flattened two rows.
My hat brim shades my eyes.
You can still back out.
I recognize what is in your hand.
Some straw has come loose.
My head is crooked.
A tear in the cloth on me.
I sway, then stand.
One stick is broken.
Straw does not know what pain is.
I slowly right my body.
Wind blows the loose straw away.
At this, I do not even sway.
You have damaged my field.
I am made of straw; I do not eat.
Do not offer it for my field.
Put it down and go.

lines.zh: 这东西不是从你地里来的
lines.en: That did not come from your field.
I will not be bought.
Put it back where it was.
I stand, and do not move.
These have no effect on me.
Lowering your hand changes nothing.
I am waiting for the truth.
I sway, but my frame holds.
Straw leaks from the seams.

lines.zh: 我站得很稳，像一根柱子
lines.en: I stand firm as a post.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，肩上扎了根草
lines.en: You hit me and got a straw on your shoulder.
I raise an arm, slowly.
You knocked my straw hat brim askew.
We collide, and only straw rustles.

lines.zh: 我退后半步，脚又钉进土
lines.en: I give half a step, then my feet bite the soil.

lines.zh: 木棍在我体内断了一根
lines.en: One of my sticks has snapped.
Do not push me; I am light.
That has nothing to do with me.
I was tied together.
There is only me in this field.
What I keep company with is not people.
The wind is my companion.
The work in the field matters more.
Guarding this field is enough.
Straw does not bloom.

lines.zh: 我只是一捆草和两根棍
lines.en: I am only straw and two sticks.
I stand. I keep standing.
I gather what was torn off.
I push them back into the soil.
My fingers do not grip well.

lines.zh: 这棵苗该在土里，不在你手里
lines.en: This sprout belongs in soil, not in your hand.
I set the flattened ones upright.

lines.zh: 我插了一根木棍做记号
lines.en: I plant a stick as a marker.
I do these things slowly.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的种子我捡了
lines.en: I pick up the fallen seeds.
I press it back into the wet soil.
I am tidying this field.
You pulled something up.

lines.zh: 你的手一伸，我就知道了
lines.en: The moment your hand reaches, I know.
This patch is under my watch.
Step back and put it down.
I stand at the row's end and wait for you.
I walk slowly, without stopping.
The field under your feet is mine.
The wind brings your smell.

lines.zh: 我的两只眼珠跟着你转
lines.en: My two painted eyes follow you.
I will not shout.

lines.zh: 我会一直站在你和田之间
lines.en: I will stand between you and the field.
This is the last time I warn you.
There is something hard in my sleeve.
You are retreating toward the fence.
There is no gate in that fence.
Here, my word is law.
I track you along the rows.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地我都看得见
lines.en: I see every patch you tread.
I am not fast, but I do not rest.
The fence blocks that way.
I cut you off at the middle of the field.
You are still holding it.
I count how many you pulled.
Straw gives me silent steps.
Wherever you go, I am ahead.
I never turn aside.
The sun is going down.
I know the field paths better than anyone.
You cannot hear me, but I am closer.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声乱了，我听得清
lines.en: Your steps have gone ragged; I hear them clearly.
You have reached the field's edge.
One more step and it is the fence.

lines.zh: 我的袖子抬起来，草在响
lines.en: My sleeve rises, rattling with straw.
Only one row remains between us.
You looked back.
Your back is to me — now is the time.
I strike with my stick arm.
There is something hard in the straw.
That hit your hand.
I bring my arm down from above.
Your hand opened.
Not fast, but heavy.
I strike your leg to bring you down.
Straw dust lands on your shoulder.
I step back and set myself.
This blow is for the field.
The blow sends you back into the rows.
My arm is still shaking.
One more and you fall.
I raise the other arm.
That one took all my strength.
You are on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你手里的东西拿回来了
lines.en: I have taken back what you held.
I plant it back.
I stand and watch you.
Do not come back.
I rise in the middle of the field.
The straw rustles once.

lines.zh: 玉米被踩倒了，我看见了
lines.en: The corn is trampled; I saw it.
I have stood in this patch a long while.
Someone touched my field.
Shadow sits under my hat.
Thunder at the horizon.
I slowly raise one arm.
The soil under me has loosened.

lines.zh: 我看见了一条新踩的路
lines.en: I see a freshly trodden path.
The wind comes from the west.
I lift my chin toward the field edge.
Straw catches fire at a touch.
I topple over entirely.
Water soaks the straw heavy.
The blast splits me in two.
Something pierces my chest.

lines.zh: 那力量让我体内的草立起来
lines.en: That force raises the straw inside me.
I do not eat; I simply stand.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，稻草烧了一角
lines.en: Lightning strikes and a corner of straw burns.
There is no field to stand on.
